name: Basis-regime spike reversion — perp-premium blowout fade (short, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: perp_spot_basis (perp minus spot) blowing out to an extreme POSITIVE spike means perp buyers are so aggressive they overpay vs spot — a transient dislocation the funding mechanism is DESIGNED to pull back toward zero (funding is the restoring force). Basis/arb desks have finite intraday capacity, so the spike over-shoots before they close it. We fade the perp premium SHORT (direction -1) and receive the positive funding carry (funding_feature) while the basis mechanically converges. funding_rate confirming (high) rules out a stale/noisy basis print. Distinct from harvesting steady carry (arbed to ~0): this is the transient over-shoot, not the level. Hold ~0.25-0.5d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the mean basis is compressed near zero in 2025-2026 (institutions arbed it) so 'extreme' spikes are just noise inside bid-ask + fees and net-of-fee edge dies. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it is inseparable from the high-funding-fade (basis and funding near-collinear) — keep only the stronger. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if convergence is slower than the hold and gets swamped by trend.
catalyst: perp basis spikes to an extreme premium with high funding — a mechanical over-shoot to fade short.
